sentences.en: The founder of Facebook, Mark Zuckerberg, is almost a casanova.
sentences.zh: 1. Facebook的创始人马克·扎克伯格几乎是个花花公子。

sentences.en: The hall was built in memory of the founder.
sentences.zh: 2. 这个大厅是为了纪念那位创始人的。

sentences.en: Mario says that Romulus is the founder of Rome.
sentences.zh: 3. 马里奥说罗慕路斯是罗马的创立者。
